name: PARAGRAPH_TERMINATION_MECHANICS
description: Investigate what controls paragraph length and what triggers -am termination. Five gaps: distribution shape, section/REGIME effects, -am trigger context, short vs long structure, header-body correlation.

gap1_distribution.title: Body Length Distribution Shape
gap1_distribution.result: Overall non-geometric (chi2=64.30, z=12.14), but this is a MIXTURE artifact. Within sections, termination is roughly memoryless: HERBAL var/mean=0.92, T=1.06 (near-geometric). BIO=5.00, Stars=2.22 (overdispersed due to folio variation).
gap1_distribution.interpretation: Each section has its own roughly geometric termination rate. No cross-line memory or state accumulation. Confirms C1237 steady-state model.

gap2_effects.title: Section & REGIME Effects on Body Length
gap2_effects.interpretation: Section explains 10.7%, REGIME 6.1%. Combined ~15%. The remaining 85% is folio/paragraph specific. BIO runs longest (thermal-intensive processes), HERBAL shortest.

gap3_am_trigger.title: -am Trigger Context

key_findings.qo_absent: qo prefix is 0% at paragraph-final -am vs 19.7% at non-final. Processing prefix never appears in termination.
key_findings.position: Para-final -am at body position 0.677 vs non-final at 0.313

gap3_am_trigger.interpretation: Paragraph-final -am is a cooling-verified shutdown: system switches from processing (qo absent) to monitoring (ch/al), cools (e-MIDDLE), checks loop (aiin), then fires -am. Structurally distinct from mid-paragraph batch-close -am.

gap4_short_vs_long.title: Short vs Long Paragraph Structure
gap4_short_vs_long.result: Structurally identical. Kernel balance, mode ratio, interleave rate all similar across length classes. Length difference is a section composition effect (SHORT=60% Stars, LONG=60% BIO), not internal structural difference.

gap5_header_body.title: Header Complexity -> Body Length
gap5_header_body.result: Header complexity does NOT predict body length. All correlations near zero. Length is externally determined, not programmed by header specification.

new_constraints.C1239: Paragraph body length is section-parameterized (F=17.35, eta2=0.107) and REGIME-parameterized (F=12.55, eta2=0.061). Within sections, termination is roughly memoryless (HERBAL var/mean=0.92, T=1.06). BIO averages 6.15 body lines, HERBAL 2.80. ~85% of length variance is folio/paragraph specific.
new_constraints.C1240: Paragraph-final -am has distinctive trigger context: qo prefix absent (0% vs 19.7% non-final), ch enriched 2.81x, al enriched 3.80x, e-MIDDLE enriched 2.53x, preceded by loop-check tokens (aiin/aiiin). Termination is a cooling-verified shutdown, not a processing operation. n=31, small sample.
new_constraints.C1241: Header complexity does not predict body length (r=-0.039 for token count, -0.072 for unique MIDDLEs). Paragraph length is externally determined, not programmed by header specification. Short and long paragraphs are structurally identical (same kernel balance, mode ratio, interleave rate).
